big: Two retirees start with the same corpus and withdraw the same amount. One retires just before a market fall, the other just after. The first runs out of money sooner. That is sequence-of-returns risk.

lines: An SWP pays a fixed amount monthly by redeeming units, so each withdrawal has a capital gain part. Poor returns early hurt more, because withdrawals shrink the corpus when it is low. A bucket plan helps: 2 to 3 years of expenses in safe liquid funds, the next 5 years in debt or hybrid, the rest in equity. Refill the safe bucket in good years and trim spending if needed.
